\section[(dialogue)]{Words from chapters 162-165 — a first pass}

\label{lesson:MR-R170-first-pass-words-from-chapters-162-165}



\begin{quote}
Say the words for patience and luck.
\end{quote}

\subsection*{Your turn}
Say these aloud:

\begin{itemize}
\raggedright
  \item to light, to put out, to jump, to call over, to thank
  \item to cool, to empty, to weigh, to check, to sign
  \item to announce, to clap, to cross, to increase, to reduce
  \item to miss; to go wrong, to improve, to get worse, to observe, to take part
\end{itemize}

\begin{tcolorbox}[breakable,colback=teal!4,colframe=teal!35!black,title={Before you move on}]
To light? (\textbf{\mr{पेटवणे}}, \emph{petavṇe}.) To put out? (\textbf{\mr{विझवणे}}, \emph{vijhavṇe}.) To jump? (\textbf{\mr{उडी} \mr{मारणे}}, \emph{uḍī mārṇe}.) To call over? (\textbf{\mr{बोलावणे}}, \emph{bolāvṇe}.) To thank? (\textbf{\mr{आभार} \mr{मानणे}}, \emph{ābhār mānṇe}.) To cool? (\textbf{\mr{थंड} \mr{करणे}}, \emph{thaṇḍ karṇe}.) To empty? (\textbf{\mr{रिकामे} \mr{करणे}}, \emph{rikāme karṇe}.) To weigh? (\textbf{\mr{वजन} \mr{करणे}}, \emph{vajan karṇe}.) To check? (\textbf{\mr{तपासणे}}, \emph{tapāsṇe}.) To sign? (\textbf{\mr{सही} \mr{करणे}}, \emph{sahī karṇe}.) To announce? (\textbf{\mr{जाहीर} \mr{करणे}}, \emph{jāhīr karṇe}.) To clap? (\textbf{\mr{टाळ्या} \mr{वाजवणे}}, \emph{ṭāḷyā vājavṇe}.) To cross? (\textbf{\mr{ओलांडणे}}, \emph{olāṇḍṇe}.) To increase? (\textbf{\mr{वाढवणे}}, \emph{vāḍhavṇe}.) To reduce? (\textbf{\mr{कमी} \mr{करणे}}, \emph{kamī karṇe}.) To miss; to go wrong? (\textbf{\mr{चुकणे}}, \emph{cukṇe}.) To improve? (\textbf{\mr{सुधारणे}}, \emph{sudhārṇe}.) To get worse? (\textbf{\mr{बिघडणे}}, \emph{bighaḍṇe}.) To observe? (\textbf{\mr{निरीक्षण} \mr{करणे}}, \emph{nirīkṣaṇ karṇe}.) To take part? (\textbf{\mr{भाग} \mr{घेणे}}, \emph{bhāg gheṇe}.)
\end{tcolorbox}
\section[(dialogue)]{Words from chapters 166-170 — a second pass}

\label{lesson:MR-R170-second-pass-words-from-chapters-166-170}



\begin{quote}
Say the words for to waste and to keep quiet.
\end{quote}

\subsection*{Your turn}
Say these aloud:

\begin{itemize}
\raggedright
  \item to waste, to keep quiet, to be afraid, to carry, to hit; to kill
  \item to breathe, to give up, to exchange, to slip, to suspect
  \item to tidy up, to notice, to be shy, to be defeated, to take cover
  \item health, the brain, a lung, the liver, a kidney
  \item shame, jealousy, boredom, patience, luck
\end{itemize}

\begin{tcolorbox}[breakable,colback=teal!4,colframe=teal!35!black,title={Before you move on}]
To waste? (\textbf{\mr{वाया} \mr{घालवणे}}, \emph{vāyā ghālavṇe}.) To keep quiet? (\textbf{\mr{गप्प} \mr{बसणे}}, \emph{gappa basṇe}.) To be afraid? (\textbf{\mr{घाबरणे}}, \emph{ghābarṇe}.) To carry? (\textbf{\mr{वाहून} \mr{नेणे}}, \emph{vāhūn neṇe}.) To hit; to kill? (\textbf{\mr{मारणे}}, \emph{mārṇe}.) To breathe? (\textbf{\mr{श्वास} \mr{घेणे}}, \emph{śvās gheṇe}.) To give up? (\textbf{\mr{सोडून} \mr{देणे}}, \emph{soḍūn deṇe}.) To exchange? (\textbf{\mr{अदलाबदल} \mr{करणे}}, \emph{adlābadal karṇe}.) To slip? (\textbf{\mr{घसरणे}}, \emph{ghasarṇe}.) To suspect? (\textbf{\mr{संशय} \mr{घेणे}}, \emph{saṁśay gheṇe}.) To tidy up? (\textbf{\mr{आवरणे}}, \emph{āvarṇe}.) To notice? (\textbf{\mr{लक्षात} \mr{येणे}}, \emph{lakṣāt yeṇe}.) To be shy? (\textbf{\mr{लाजणे}}, \emph{lājṇe}.) To be defeated? (\textbf{\mr{हरणे}}, \emph{harṇe}.) To take cover? (\textbf{\mr{लपणे}}, \emph{lapṇe}.) Health? (\textbf{\mr{आरोग्य}}, \emph{ārogya}.) The brain? (\textbf{\mr{मेंदू}}, \emph{mendū}.) A lung? (\textbf{\mr{फुफ्फुस}}, \emph{phuphphus}.) The liver? (\textbf{\mr{यकृत}}, \emph{yakṛt}.) A kidney? (\textbf{\mr{मूत्रपिंड}}, \emph{mūtrapiṇḍ}.) Shame? (\textbf{\mr{लाज}}, \emph{lāj}.) Jealousy? (\textbf{\mr{मत्सर}}, \emph{matsar}.) Boredom? (\textbf{\mr{कंटाळा}}, \emph{kaṇṭāḷā}.) Patience? (\textbf{\mr{संयम}}, \emph{saṁyam}.) Luck? (\textbf{\mr{नशीब}}, \emph{naśīb}.)
\end{tcolorbox}
